name: cdm/base/datetime/Frequency
description: A class for defining a date frequency, e.g. one day, three months, through the combination of an integer value and a standardized period value that is specified as part of an enumeration.

period.description: A time period, e.g. a day, week, month, year or term of the stream.

periodMultiplier.description: A time period multiplier, e.g. 1, 2, or 3. If the period value is T (Term) then period multiplier must contain the value 1.
